title: The 1→15 Repurposing Engine: tool overwhelm → cut my workload in half, using content repurposing
caption:
tool overwhelm → cut my workload in half, using content repurposing

Here's the exact playbook:
1️⃣ Start with one pillar — A webinar, a long post, or a podcast episode — one meaty idea.
2️⃣ Cut 3 angles from it — A how-to, a mistake-to-avoid, and a contrarian take on the same idea.
3️⃣ Each angle → 5 formats — Carousel, short video, text post, quote graphic, email.
4️⃣ Spread across 3 weeks — One pillar feeds 15 posts. Never stare at a blank feed again.
